Stochastic character mapping (phytools::make.simmap) was attempted first; its rejection sampler does not converge for

Median P(absent at FSM crown node)
Families with zero changes within FSM
The loss therefore maps to the FSM stem, not to repeated independent loss in deep sublineages. The within-FSM changes
(median 1) are sporadic reappearances consistent with the 5.4% residual prevalence, and because the crown node is reconstructed
as absent these are gains rather than further losses. Caveat: these families are homoplastic genus-wide (median 6 changes
across the whole tree). The reconstruction constrains where FSM lost them, not how labile they are in the genus.
